messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: SMART_ROUTER_HIGH_MISROUTES in eu-west-1 — 3xx/5xx model variant mismatches. Paging Sasha (oncall).
Sasha (oncall): on it, grabbing context. what's the impact?
Priya (customer-success): customer-reports: visible hallucinations & inconsistent outputs for a subset of calls. A handful of enterprise customers flagged, roughly 100-150 reqs/min from EU accounts. seeing negative CSAT messages.
Ben (eng-runtime): i'm seeing a spike in 'variant_mismatch' in router metrics. fallback policy is aggressively routing to 'x-small-quant' variant for latency tier, but some requests need 'x-large' precision.
Mara (eng-sre): confirm error/latency graphs — increased tail latency in eu-west pool and elevated 502-like responses from downstream model adapters.
Sasha (oncall): assign to Ben for root cause and Mara for mitigation/ops. @Ben please take primary, @Mara please coordinate region-level mitigations.
Ben (eng-runtime): taking. quick check: decision logs for affected requests show route_id and candidate list, but variant field often null. that smells like logging/serialization bug in decision tracer.
Luca (eng-platform): noted — we pushed a logging change yesterday to reduce payload size. could be related.
Priya (customer-success): customers want a timeline and if there's data exposure. any PII risk?
Mara (eng-sre): nothing indicates PII; it's model selection mismatch only. will confirm after we collect traces.
Ben (eng-runtime): collecting a few failing request ids now. running query against decision-store:

```
SELECT * FROM decision_logs
WHERE timestamp > 1678000000
AND route_tag IS NULL
AND region = 'eu-west-1'
LIMIT 50;
```

Ben (eng-runtime): results: many entries have "route_tag": null and "variant": null, but "chosen_model": "x-small-quant". upstream policy expected 'x-large'
Sasha (oncall): so decision service made wrong pick, or router didn't annotate trace properly. need to know if fallback policy mis-evaluated capacity.
Ben (eng-runtime): looking at policy-eval traces — policy matched 'fallback-to-low-cost' because capacity_estimate flag returned low capacity for primary pool. but capacity_estimate seems stale (calls returning -1).
Mara (eng-sre): do we have pod-level metrics for eu-west primary pool? any autoscale flaps?
Ben (eng-runtime): checking kube events:

```
kubectl get hpa -n inference eu-primary-hpa
# shows scale from 12 -> 3 around 06:12 UTC
kubectl describe deploy eu-primary
# 2026-03-15T06:12:12 Kube OOMKilled on node gpu-5
```

Ben (eng-runtime): OOMKilled + HPA reduced capacity -> policy saw low capacity and triggered aggressive fallback. fallback variant is lower-quality and shouldn't be used for some customer routes (route_tag enforcement missing).
Sasha (oncall): that's sticky: we have two issues: (1) autoscale/flap caused capacity drop, (2) routing policy/observability didn't honor route-level constraints because route tags missing from decision logs. both need fix and quick mitigation.
Mara (eng-sre): mitigation plan: 1) scale eu-primary to emergency min 8 gpus, 2) temporarily disable 'aggressive_fallback' policy in eu-west, 3) add a manual override to pin key customers to x-large model until stable.
Ben (eng-runtime): I can push a policy toggle. proposing:

```
POST /admin/policies/toggle
Body: { "policy": "aggressive_fallback", "region": "eu-west-1", "enabled": false }
```

Ben (eng-runtime): also will add a guard: if request has customer_tier == "enterprise" then do not fall back to variants with quality_score < 0.8.
Sasha (oncall): do it. prioritize manual pin for flagged customer_tiers.
Luca (eng-platform): on the observability side: decision logs pipeline dropped route_tag during yesterday's transformation. looks like a schema migration removed 'route_tag' field when size-cutting. i'll revert that transform and reprocess recent logs.
Ben (eng-runtime): note — reprocessing won't fix real-time decisions. need runtime guard to fail open to safe policy (i.e., prefer higher-quality model for enterprise routes when logs missing).
Mara (eng-sre): executing scale now: `kubectl scale deploy/eu-primary --replicas=8 -n inference` — started. watch pods for readiness.
Mara (eng-sre): also applying iptable node-level throttles for non-prod to reduce noisy neighbor risk.
Priya (customer-success): telling customers we're aware, working on mitigation, no evidence of data exposure, ETA 30-60m for stable service. sharing advisory to affected customers.
Sasha (oncall): Ben, please post the exact command used to toggle the policy and the commit id for the guard rule.
Ben (eng-runtime): posted toggle.

```
# admin CLI
ri-admin policy toggle --name aggressive_fallback --region eu-west-1 --off
# guard rule commit
commit: 4b9f7a2 (patch: enforce enterprise-tier pin)
```

Ben (eng-runtime): applied guard rule as hotfix. routing metrics show fallback rate dropping and chosen_model shifting back to x-large for enterprise routes.
Mara (eng-sre): eu-primary pods back to Ready=8/8 within 12m, OOM issue trigger: a nightly maintenance job was mis-scheduled on gpu-5 causing memory pressure. draining node and cordon in progress.
Luca (eng-platform): re-enabled route_tag in decision pipeline; pushing a small migration to ensure route_tag is present with default 'unknown' if missing. will follow up with reprocess job id rj-20260315-07
Ben (eng-runtime): still seeing a handful of decision logs with variant null. snippet:

```
{"request_id":"req-9f3a","route_tag":null,"policy_decision":"fallback","variant":null,"chosen_model":"x-small-quant"}
```

Ben (eng-runtime): adding logging patch to emitter to include 'variant' and 'route_tag' before serialization.
Sasha (oncall): good. are we paging any other teams?
Mara (eng-sre): pinged infra on node maintenance schedule. pinged runtime to confirm hotfix.
Priya (customer-success): customers replied, mostly relieved; one asked for credit and postmortem. logging for impacted requests requested.
Sasha (oncall): action items so far: (A) Mara — scale & node cordon (in progress), (B) Ben — hotfix guard rule + logging patch (done/applied), (C) Luca — revert transform & reprocess (in progress), (D) Priya — customer comms + credits plan. please update tickets.
Ben (eng-runtime): filing a follow-up issue: ROUTER-3142 (add invariant check: route_tag && variant present for decision logging).
Luca (eng-platform): reprocess job scheduled. reprocessing window will cover last 6h. I'll surface any missing customer requests to Priya.
Mara (eng-sre): mitigation looks stable. fallback rate in eu-west down from 22% -> 2% for enterprise routes. latency normalized.
Sasha (oncall): handing off to Ben for remaining runtime cleanup. Ben you're now primary owner. I'll stay as incident coordinator until postmortem.
Ben (eng-runtime): ack. I'll keep updates in the ticket and post the postmortem draft when we have RCA.
Priya (customer-success): noted — will prepare a customer-facing summary and schedule a follow-up with affected accounts.
Luca (eng-platform): follow-ups: add schema tests to decision-pipeline CI, add alert for 'route_tag drop rate > 0.5%'.
Sasha (oncall): thanks team. final check: any suspected data exposure? explicitly no.
Priya (customer-success): confirmed no PII surfaced. only output quality issues.
incident-bot: Incident 2026-03-15T07:05: Alert cleared by Sasha (oncall). Status: mitigated; owner: Ben (eng-runtime); follow-up: ROUTER-3142, platform reprocess rj-20260315-07, postmortem in 48h.
Sasha (oncall): closing thread — will coordinate postmortem doc. :white_check_mark:
